user.title: Log in to De'Longhi
user.description: Open [this link]({delonghi_login_url}) in your browser to log in to De'Longhi. At the end you should be redirected to Google and the URL will contain `?code=st2.s...(random_characters)...st3`. Your login token starts with `st2` and ends with `st3`. Copy it into the field below.
